# Run: python3 quiz.py
qa = [
    ("What is Marketplace?", "the platform hosting many sellers"),
    ("What is Fulfillment?", "ship fast with tracking; pack well"),
    ("State one governing principle of e-commerce basics.", "Price with all fees and shipping included in the math."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
demo.note: Runnable Python self-quiz. Run with: python3 quiz.py
